name: A Series Of Fortunate Events
source: This is a short tale of twists and turns, where you play as a student visiting his hometown for the first time in two years. With your girlfriend in hand, you embark upon a series of fortunate events…
translation: 这是一部一波三折的短篇故事，你将扮演时隔两年首度返乡探亲的男大学生。携女友同行的你，即将迎来一连串艳福不浅的幸运奇遇……
